name: app-visual-design-tilted-hand-held-phone-over-faded-screen-row
title: Hand-Held Health Home over Faded Screens
whatItIs: A pale slide with a numbered Visual design pill, a headline about finding events, a row of five phones (onboarding, login, sign up, reports) fading at the edges and a large tilted hand-held phone in front showing a blood sugar home with pastel metric cards.
whatItMeans: The large hand-held phone breaks the row of screens for a focal moment, and faded edges add depth.
techniques: Large tilted phone overlapping a row
Edge fade on the outer screens
Pastel metric cards in blue, lilac, green and peach
Blue gradient pills on auth screens

vocabulary.definition: A large device overlapping a row of smaller ones.
Outer items fading to suggest continuation.
A pastel card showing one health measure.
